title: Blitch vets Barber's four-man team on his boat

tellings.quote: I was looking for inconsistencies between those folks it's

plain: Around 2024 or 2025, a scientist named John Blitch, who worked for the Pentagon's advanced research agency, brought a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber and Barber's four-man team onto his boat to vet their story about retrieving crashed craft. Blitch tells it himself and says he "was looking for inconsistencies between those folks", to see whether their accounts held together.
